qa_pairs.question: What are the key advantages of using tape as a storage medium for the /nearline system compared to disk or solid-state drives?
qa_pairs.answer: Tape storage offers several benefits for the /nearline system over disk and solid-state (SSD) media, including a lower cost per unit of data stored, the ability to easily expand the volume of data by purchasing more tapes, and effectively zero energy consumption per unit of data stored.

qa_pairs.question: How does storing inactive data on the /nearline system improve the performance and management of the /project filesystem?
qa_pairs.answer: Storing inactive data on /nearline significantly benefits the /project filesystem by reducing the load and backup demands on it, which in turn improves its overall performance.
